complexity.notes: s.lower() creates an O(n) copy of the string; comparing characters on the fly with case folding would reduce auxiliary space to O(1). Pointer-skipping loops are safe since b cannot pass a, which always rests on an alphanumeric character.
complexity.summary: Lowercases the string, then uses two pointers from both ends, skipping non-alphanumeric characters and comparing characters until they meet or a mismatch is found.
